data.name: Piece of Memory 2:Prologue
data.detailed_description:
---- Story ------------------------------------------
"Piece of memory2 prologue" is the sequel of "Piece of memory".
You can play without completing "Piece of memory", but in order to understand and enjoy the background, we recommend to play and complete "Piece of memory" first.

Lily and Nekokun landed on the Earth where the environment has been drastically changed because of the crashes between the planets of the solar system. After they have awaken the people from cold sleeping, they became unconscious and heard Lily's mother's voice to. They must go to the Dome, the Global Environment Inspection Bureau. Sneaking in a freight train they are now heading to the Dome.



---- Getting Started ---------------------------------------
Start the game and find Lily and Nekokun on the roof of a freight train.
Proceed with controlling Nekokun.

Use mouse and keyboards to control Nekokun.
You see cursor arrows on the screen so click the direction you'd like to go.

When clicking the direction, press key Ctrl simultaneously then Nekokun could run except for when on the roof of the freight train.

When clicking the direction, press key Alt simultaneously e then Nekokun could look around.



When you see [Action!] on the screen press key A to take some actions.
For example,
"climb steps"
"jump over a ditch
"Pick up an item"
"Open the door"
Don't miss it!

Press key Esc then you can quit the game. You can't quit while fighting or during some other occasions.

Press key F5 then you can get a screenshots and save them in the folder "photo" in "PoM2_prologue".

Press key F9 to save the game at the point you've proceeded.
You can't save while fighting or during some other occasions.
You can save if you see "[F9]=GAMESAVE" in the bottom of the screen.
Use ">>" or "

----- Additions : Keyboad Operation -----------------------------------------
--Normal movement--
-Cursor keys-
Up
down
left
right
Up + left
Up + right
down + left
down + right

--Operation at the roof of a freight car--
-Cursor keys-
Up
down
left
right

--Item acquisition--
A = Erase window

reviews.review:
If you are intrigued by its strange and rather unique style you should give it a try.
Its around an hour long and for its price I was entertained enough.

As someone who has played "Piece of Memory", I simply had to know how this would continue.
This loosely continues the story of the previous game but can be followed regardless of whether you played the first game or not.

The title menu music is still by far the best part of the entire game. You can find all the music and ambient tracks as wavesound files in the installation folder.

The controls are still as awkward as in the first game but not impossible to get used to. You move with the mouse by clicking on directional prompts that appear on the screen.

The gameplay mostly revolves around traveling and exploration. 
You are a cat and walk around an area with the girl. Listen to their conversation for instructions, clues and the story. Find certain key items to progress.
There are some simple turn based RPG elements but with a little strategy you'll be able to easily dispose of your enemies.

From what I can tell the Japanese voice acting is good. The English subtitles not so much but its not complete gibberish. I'd almost say the translation has a certain charm to it.

To prevent frustration I recommend to frequently save. There will be events happening that might end in a Game Over.

It ended on quite a cliffhanger but there is definitely a lot of creativity that went into this. 
And that is something I can always appreciate.
